systems.system: plateforme numérique nationale de l'état civil / registre national de l'état civil
systems.tiers: civil-status offices of the communes; access for commune presidents and civil-status agents is to be opened 'soon' through secured accounts, and paper registers are still being scanned in ten regions

note: The national civil-status platform is an application, and the report (October 2025, on unnamed sources) says commune staff's access to it is still to be opened; no connection at a commune office is stated, and communes are reported short of paper registers for births.
